test_respond: test the RepeatQueryAgent respond method with a single message and verify it echoes the text
test_respond_error: test the RepeatQueryAgent respond method raises an exception when the message has no text field
test_batch_respond: test the RepeatQueryAgent batch_respond method with a list of messages and verify echoed responses
test_batch_act: test the RepeatQueryAgent batch_act method with observations and verify reply structure and text
create_agent: create a RepeatQueryAgent using create_agent with model set to repeat_query for echoing messages
